# Resource Engine

> Python framework for declarative business backends. A `Resource` declares an entity's schemas, CRUD operations, state machine, actions, hooks and document slots; the `ResourceManager` runs every operation through one lifecycle (validation, permissions, hooks, one transaction, audit, events after commit). Domain code is plain Python; FastAPI, SQLAlchemy and brokers are adapters.

Rules that must not be broken: no external effects before commit; state changes only through transitions; no framework imports in `domain/`; permissions in policies, not hooks; document every functional element. Verify with `resource-engine check --json`, `resource-engine docs validate --strict` and `pytest`.

## Skill

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): when to use the skill, workflow, rules, verification commands
- [Project catalogue](project.md): this project's resources, operations, transitions, actions and permissions (generated)
